verification.loginBrandColors: Build 045: See Everything, Connect Everything, Work Smarter, and One World. One System. One Intelligent Network. are dark blue; Maximus is blue and Optimus is white with dark contrast outline.
verification.shieldAsset: Build 046 uses repository-root shield.jpg for the login shield and Global Command Center header brandmark.
verification.loginHeader: Build 048 keeps the login masthead as one continuous panel and refines type scale, spacing, brandmark sizing, form styling, and mobile layout.
verification.loginAssets: Build 048 fixes the publishing root cause: the Pages workflow now copies shield.jpg and background.png into the published site alongside index.html and app-version.json.

notes: Build 048 fixes missing image assets in the published Pages output: the workflow previously copied only index.html and app-version.json, so shield.jpg and background.png were not deployed and appeared broken/missing. The workflow now copies both assets. Login masthead typography, spacing, responsive layout, and form styling were refined while preserving environment-specific colors and the single continuous header.
